_comment: Named differences from the Dependabot rules of templates/dependabot.yml, read by scripts/check-dependabot-drift.py. Each entry names one repo, one ecosystem, one rule and a reason. The rule is the id that the drift check prints, for example 'ignore:google.golang.org/grpc' or 'missing-entry'. An entry that exempts no finding fails the check, so this list cannot rot.

exceptions.reason: The only go.mod files are the fixtures of the CodeQL queries under actions/codeql-queries/go/tests. A fixture pins the module versions that its expected result needs.
The Claude Code version in tools/claude is the one that the stream-json fixtures came from. A bump captures the fixtures again by hand.
pnpm is bumped by hand together with packageManager in the root package.json.
A grpc release line inside the range of a reachable advisory is held back. The comment above the entry in the Dependabot file of the repo states the range and when the entry leaves.
